{
  "id": "my-brand",
  "name": "Civic public",
  "tags": [
    "government",
    "public-service",
    "civic",
    "accessible",
    "forms",
    "education",
    "trust",
    "neutral"
  ],
  "axes": {
    "formality": 4,
    "energy": 2,
    "era": 3,
    "warmth": 2,
    "density": 2,
    "richness": 1,
    "seriousness": 5
  },
  "concept": "A public-service portal: plain, high-contrast, generous type, numbered steps and unmistakable actions; dignity through clarity.",
  "rationale": [
    "Blue signals trust and is safe for colour-vision deficiencies; it doubles as info so there is one blue.",
    "Accent at step 700 (deep civic blue, ~9:1) rather than the lightest passing step: public-service actions should read as firm and official, not airy.",
    "17px base and large targets: citizens of every age and device.",
    "Modest display ratio (1.25): clarity over drama."
  ],
  "seeds": {
    "brand": {
      "hue": 255,
      "chroma": 0.13
    },
    "neutral": {
      "hue": 255,
      "tint": 0.005
    },
    "signature": {
      "hue": 85,
      "chroma": 0.16
    },
    "signatureStep": 300,
    "accentStep": 700
  },
  "type": {
    "base": 17,
    "ratio": 1.2,
    "displayRatio": 1.25
  },
  "fits": [
    "government and public services",
    "education portals",
    "NGOs"
  ],
  "avoid": [
    "luxury",
    "brand-led marketing"
  ],
  "layout": "Single column 720 for tasks; numbered step list; left nav for long guides.",
  "components": [
    "Buttons 48px, radius 4, full labels (\"Nộp hồ sơ\").",
    "Inputs 48px, hint above field.",
    "Error summary at top of form linking to fields."
  ],
  "do": [
    "Number steps.",
    "Write at plain-language level.",
    "Make focus extra visible."
  ],
  "dont": [
    "Icons without labels.",
    "Grey text below 4.5:1.",
    "Decorative imagery."
  ],
  "motifs": [
    {
      "name": "official-banner",
      "use": "Top strip stating the official site/service. Once, at the very top."
    }
  ],
  "roles": {
    "canvas": "xam-50",
    "surface": "#ffffff",
    "surface-sunken": "xam-100",
    "surface-hover": "xam-100",
    "rule": "xam-200",
    "border": "xam-500",
    "border-strong": "xam-600",
    "subtle": "xam-600",
    "muted": "xam-700",
    "ink": "xam-950",
    "accent": "xanh-cong-700",
    "accent-hover": "xanh-cong-800",
    "accent-soft": "xanh-cong-50",
    "accent-text": "xanh-cong-700",
    "focus-ring": "xanh-cong-200",
    "on-accent": "#ffffff",
    "focus": "xanh-cong-700",
    "brand": "xanh-cong-800",
    "on-brand": "xam-50",

  },
  "contrasts": [

    {

      "ratio": 3.16
    }
  ],
